independent_reviews.scope: GG2 highest-vector projection; report sections 3.3–3.5 and 4: direct cutoff stability, generic degree bound, signed auxiliary flow and actual image-lattice lifting; GG6–GG7 projection, saturation and determinant costs.
independent_reviews.result: Passed with no substantive correction. Checked vanishing of U_0 at the top allowed first weight, preservation of all lower weights by the covariant image, the generic W_0^o coefficient degree bound, signed flow including negative c, restriction of every raising power, degree-zero lifting of auxiliary highest vectors, original-degree extraction, and A+2b=(K+3)e1+4D4.

independent_reviews.scope: Report section 2 and sections 5–8, with the intervening auxiliary argument read for consistency: exact same-coordinate D and 4D weight widths; multiplicity-safe divided-power generation; cutoff shifts; actual initial-lattice saturation; orthogonal projection domain; primitive partners and Smith form; logarithmic and segment application constants.
independent_reviews.result: Passed after the stated zero-z projection clarification. No substantive algebra or constant error found; the exact full-word HypP/HypW and tie-prefix GramDeterminantGradedHypothesis applications were checked.

corrections_required.issue: The canonical type and highest-vector projectors preserve z-independence but do not impose it on the full reduced coefficient space; therefore their range is XH only after the z-free domain is made explicit.
corrections_required.resolution: The report and main section now begin this construction with the integral self-adjoint coefficient projection to z-degree zero. It commutes with every subsequent projector and has zero denominator cost. The original-word construction separately retains z-degree e before stripping it.

claims.statement: The signed prefix coordinate width is at most D, yielding HypP, HypE and HypW with e1=binom(r,2)Nat.log_p(D+r-1). HypE is the matching smaller-group type projector on a fixed full weight. Highest-vector generation works on an entire isotypic module with multiplicities and requires no integral irreducible splitting.

claims.title: Explicit auxiliary GL action, integral divided powers and finite weight width
claims.statement: The literal XSp direct sum is stable under EX. A direct first-weight argument bypasses rational-surjectivity/Omega injectivity. Generic W-coordinate evaluation gives o<=c+D_early, and all auxiliary weight coordinates lie in [-D_early,c+2D_early], so the width is <=4D. The formal U-flow proves root divided-power integrality for every integer c.

claims.title: The actual restriction-image lattice lifts after precisely two IW losses
claims.statement: For every integral x in the literal XSp at the original last degree, an integral h in the literal Y has h|_(z=0)=p^(2D4)x. M2 is divided-power stable and contains all integral auxiliary highest vectors, which have last degree zero. Type isolation and highest generation each cost D4, and extracting the original degree yields the actual lift.
